Z1-ziggurat.note: Summit cut flat at 165 mm for the lich and obelisk; stair faces +x in the file (rotate in the slicer as needed). Print hollow, 2-3 walls, sparse infill, 0.12-0.16 mm layers.

C1-causeway-a.note: Ends and bottom cut flat; sits on the water surface. Segment a from the front-left landing, b to the stair foot.

C1-causeway-b.note: Ends and bottom cut flat; sits on the water surface. Segment a from the front-left landing, b to the stair foot.

T1-dead-tree.note: Root mound sits on the mud bank at the left edge. Tree supports; the beaded moss strands will need cleanup (or swap for real lichen).

T2-dead-tree-mirrored.note: T1 mirrored at 0.95x, right edge beside the temple.

S1-priest-statue.note: 95 mm; resin keeps the sun-disc staff. FDM works too if the staff is thickened.

S3-leaning-statue.note: S1 at 1.2x, leaning 20 deg; cut flat at the waterline so it stands leaning.

S2-fallen-statue-a.note: S1 lying face up, half sunk; cut at the waterline.

S2-fallen-statue-b.note: S1 lying face up, half sunk; cut at the waterline.

K2-skeleton-0-wading.note: K2-skeleton-sword at 1.1x, cut at the waterline (8 mm deep); glue onto the water.

K1-skeleton-1-wading.note: K1-skeleton-shield at 1.1x, cut at the waterline (9 mm deep); glue onto the water.

K2-skeleton-2-wading.note: K2-skeleton-sword at 1.1x, cut at the waterline (8 mm deep); glue onto the water.

K1-skeleton-3-wading.note: K1-skeleton-shield at 1.1x, cut at the waterline (7 mm deep); glue onto the water.

K1-skeleton-4-stair.note: K1-skeleton-shield full figure on its base, stands on tier 1 left of the stair.

P1-pillar-0-h60.note: Top 60 mm of the pillar (broken top kept), standing in the water.

P1-pillar-1-h40.note: Top 40 mm of the pillar (broken top kept), standing in the water.

P1-fallen-column-5.note: Top 30 mm of the pillar; lay it on its side in the water by T2.

P1-pillar-6-h25.note: Top 25 mm of the pillar (broken top kept), standing in the water.

X1-brazier.note: Stone block, bowl and flame; 2 on the summit front corners, 2 at the stair foot. Overlapping parts are unioned by the slicer.

R1-reeds.note: Reed clump on a 12 mm disc; blades 1.6 mm at the root. Print a plate of them; glue around banks, causeway and temple. Scale 0.8-1.3x for variety.

O1-obelisk.note: Obelisk with horned cradle, 0.75x (about 70 mm). Drill a 1.1 mm hole at the cradle centre for the crystal pin.

O1-crystal.note: Octahedral crystal on a 1.1 mm pin; clear resin, can be lit from below.

G1-swamp-tile-F1.note: Base tile F1 (x 0-255, y 0-220 mm in the 510 x 440 base; F = front row, B = back row, 1 = left, 2 = right). Underside has half-slots for the tile clips at every internal seam.

G1-swamp-tile-F2.note: Base tile F2 (x 255-510, y 0-220 mm in the 510 x 440 base; F = front row, B = back row, 1 = left, 2 = right). Underside has half-slots for the tile clips at every internal seam.

G1-swamp-tile-B1.note: Base tile B1 (x 0-255, y 220-440 mm in the 510 x 440 base; F = front row, B = back row, 1 = left, 2 = right). Underside has half-slots for the tile clips at every internal seam.

G1-swamp-tile-B2.note: Base tile B2 (x 255-510, y 220-440 mm in the 510 x 440 base; F = front row, B = back row, 1 = left, 2 = right). Underside has half-slots for the tile clips at every internal seam.

G1-tile-clip.note: Press or glue into the underside slots across each seam (8 slots).
